38d29755ef4a33d1.title: Near infrared spectroscopy during non-ischaemic handgrip exercise reveals divergent muscle oxygenation signatures in mitochondrial disease and sarcopenia
digest: Background: Mitochondrial dysfunction is a hallmark of ageing and is implicated in the pathogenesis of sarcopenia.

Findings were compared with 23 community-dwelling older adults from the Muscle Ageing and Sarcopenia Study (MASS) Lifecourse cohort (n=23, 13 female) including seven with probable or confirmed sarcopenia according to European Working Group on Sarcopenia in Older People (EWGSOP2) criteria.
Total haemoglobin (THb) responses did not differ between groups (p=0.10).

results.verbatim: Results: Participants with mitochondrial disease demonstrated an attenuated reduction in tissue saturation index (TSI) during exercise compared with controls (TSI % {middle dot} s150-180s: -59.9 {+/-} 94.5 vs -175.1 {+/-} 128.4; p=0.02).
Total haemoglobin (THb) responses did not differ between groups (p=0.10).

In contrast, participants with probable or confirmed sarcopenia showed exaggerated reduction in TSI compared with non-sarcopenic participants (TSI % {middle dot} s150-180s: -256.5 {+/-} 146.0 vs -121.2 {+/-} 95.2; p=0.05), while THb responses remained similar.
The association between sarcopenia and TSI differed by sex (interaction coefficient -240, p=0.016), with greater TSI reductions observed in males with sarcopenia.

evidence.quote: Near infrared spectroscopy during non-ischaemic handgrip exercise reveals divergent muscle oxygenation signatures in mitochondrial disease and sarcopenia.

ab3969fe769a6c8d.title: A scalable in vitro cell competition model identifies preleukemic super competitor clones
digest: Preleukemic and leukemic conditions are frequently characterized by the acquisition of recurrent genetic mutations in hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs).

We identify a novel preleukemic cell phenotype that parallels the developmental biology phenomenon of super-competition, whereby ~10% of TET2-mutant clones actively and selectively suppress wild type (WT) cell expansion and, in some cases, completely eliminate WT clones.

evidence.quote: One of the most frequently mutated genes in both clonal hematopoiesis and myeloid malignancies is the ten-eleven translocation 2 (TET2) gene, which encodes an epigenetic enzyme with a critical role in the regulation of gene transcription.

digest: Aging is characterized by progressive functional decline, yet metabolomic signatures across the human life span remain incompletely defined.

Here, we profiled plasma metabolomes from 18,476 participants aged 1 to 96 years across six centers in China using nano-assisted laser desorption/ionization mass spectrometry (LDI-MS) and identified 56 representative age-associated metabolites.

f0e964428ccd0fad.title: FDA has finalized its guidance on apps related to drugs, pharma rejoices
digest: You’re reading the web edition of STAT’s Health Tech newsletter, our guide to how technology is transforming the life sciences.
Today, a look at FDA’s final guidance on drug-related apps and what it means for the future of digital therapeutics.
Plus the latest in Katie’s reporting on marketing drugs over telehealth.

df41ca7e5000ee9b.title: The human gut microbiome primes fever after vaccination.
digest: Fever is a common adverse reaction to vaccination, contributing to vaccine hesitancy and reduced uptake.

To understand variation in fever risk, we longitudinally profiled fecal microbiota, oral temperature, and serological markers in 171 healthy adults receiving Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 mRNA vaccines.
Moreover, microbiome flagellin phenotypes and murine vaccine reactions were modifiable by diet.

cc1312cddbaaa472.title: Oral deucrictibant for on-demand treatment of hereditary angioedema attacks: a phase 3, multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial.
digest: Background In hereditary angioedema, a rare bradykinin-mediated condition, oral on-demand treatments facilitating prompt administration and providing rapid, sustained relief and attack resolution remain scant.
Methods RAPIDe-3 was a phase 3, double-blind, 2 × 2 crossover trial in adolescent and adult participants (aged ≥12 to 12), respectively (p<0·0001).
Interpretation Oral deucrictibant provided faster times to symptom relief than placebo and was generally well tolerated.

b7231662038cd327.title: STAT3 operates as an inflammation-dependent transcriptional switch in antiviral NK cells.
digest: The immune system integrates signals to regulate immune responses, forming complex context-dependent networks where identical cues produce distinct outcomes.
How concurrent STAT activation across different environments shapes immune cell function remains unclear.

Mechanistically, STAT3 differentially regulates downstream transcription factors MYB and B lymphocyte-induced maturation protein-1 (BLIMP-1) to shape NK cell differentiation during homeostasis and infection.
